# @stackline/cardinal

> Cardinal 2.1.1-compatible JavaScript and JSON terminal highlighting with reliable streams, named themes, ESM, browser bundles, and TypeScript declarations.

- Package: @stackline/cardinal@{{PACKAGE_VERSION}}
- Install: npm install @stackline/cardinal
- Legacy alias: npm install cardinal@npm:@stackline/cardinal
- Runtime: Node.js 12+; browser bundle for string highlighting
- API: highlight, highlightFile, highlightFileSync
- CLI: cdl
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-cardinal
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/cardinal
- Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/cardinal/
- Security: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-cardinal/blob/main/SECURITY.md

Runtime chain: ansicolors -> @stackline/ansicolors@1.0.1; redeyed -> @stackline/redeyed@1.0.2; esprima -> @stackline/esprima@1.0.0. All aliases are exact and preserve historical dependency keys.
